download:cdp_centerlines.limitation: Chicago Data Portal centerlines (pr57-gg9e) are a periodic snapshot (map view 6imu-meau dated August 2016) and carry no bridge, tunnel or pedestrian-access attributes; those come from OSM or stay Unknown.

download:cta_gtfs.limitation: CTA GTFS is a schedule feed; stations are GTFS parent stations. Wheelchair boarding is Unknown where the feed does not state it. It says nothing about service disruptions.

download:osm_buildings.limitation: OSM building height and floor tags are sparse; building height class is Unknown where tags are absent. Multipolygon relations are not downloaded; only building ways.

download:osm_pedestrian.limitation: OSM pedestrian coverage (walkways, steps, indoor corridors, skywalk or underpass tagging) is incomplete; Level_Transition and accessibility data may be Unknown.

download:osm_streets.limitation: OSM street attributes (bridge, tunnel, layer, access, oneway) are volunteer-contributed and incomplete; missing values are kept Unknown and penalized, never assumed safe.

elevation:limitation.warning: USGS 3DEP is bare-earth terrain (NAVD 88). It does not represent bridge decks, tunnels or underground levels, and higher terrain does not guarantee flood safety.

elevation:partial_coverage.warning: 20004 of 51604 node elevations are Unknown (no 3DEP data or request failures).

emergency_plan:cbd_plan_2007.limitation: Historical (2007) plan used for planning concepts only; never an active Official_Notice. Appendices (CPD, OEMC, CTA, IDOT) and any newer plan version were not located publicly; their content is left unpopulated.

incidental_mentions.excerpt: te a location to meet in case it is impossible to return home or if you have to evacuate

official_sources:oemc_public_evacuation_.limitation: SafePath states no OEMC evacuation procedure; it links to OEMC only.
official_sources:oemc_public_evacuation_.reason: no current public evacuation procedure found on the OEMC pages read (only generic family-planning mentions); SafePath links to OEMC and does not state any OEMC evacuation procedure

synthetic_fixture_graph.fallback: Synthetic Chicago-like street grid used when real street downloads are unavailable.
synthetic_fixture_graph.limitation: SIMULATED. Street geometry, bridges, tunnels, one-way flags, elevations and buildings are invented for development, CI and demos. They do not represent real Chicago streets and must not be used for real navigation or evacuation guidance.
